title: Fix Board Scene Selection Freeze
description: Investigate and fix board scene freeze caused by selecting an object, which triggers a TransformControls/updateMatrixWorld stack overflow in the elements board scene. Validate the root cause in the scene implementation, apply a minimal fix in existing files, and run relevant tests.
summary: Fixed board scene selection freeze by moving scene object TransformControls out of the controlled object subtree via a portal to the scene root, which removes the recursive updateMatrixWorld loop. Added scene play harness hooks and extended the existing scene Playwright spec to cover programmatic activate-selection of relocate controls and assert the console stays free of stack-overflow/updateMatrixWorld regressions.
